title: 8 cyclic cube fields with weight-conditioned admission

claims.statement: The explicit 8-field degree-125 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-27 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 20072386508990609/250000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=1891535973990986868106847676987599045627015342793609452 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(22538/125).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles (0), orbit count, nominal tails, field and operation bound (1), auxiliary child tails (2), and weighted admission and occupancy (3).
